paper_title: SepLLM Accelerate Large Language Models by Compressing One Segment into   One Separator
caption: : Loss steps
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of iterations and loss values for several models. The x-axis is labeled "#Iteration" and spans from 0 to 140000, with tick labels at intervals of 20000, and the scale is linear. The y-axis is labeled "Loss" and ranges from 2.4 to 3.4, with tick labels at intervals of 0.1, and the scale is linear. A purple solid line with no markers represents "Vanilla," beginning at a value of approximately 3.3 and decreasing to approximately 2.6 by the end of the x-axis. An orange dashed line with no markers represents "StrmLLM," starting at a value of about 3.3 and declining to approximately 2.6. A green solid line with no markers represents "SepLLM (n=64, H)," starting at approximately 3.3 and decreasing to roughly 2.6. A red solid line with no markers represents "SepLLM (n=64, H/T)," initiating at a value of approximately 3.3 and ending at approximately 2.6. A blue solid line with no markers represents "SepLLM (n=128)," beginning at approximately 3.3 and decreasing to roughly 2.6.
